meta.title: Jackson Football Coaching — Duval County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Jacksonville, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Jackson
about.bio:
Played 4 years of high school football at Stanton College Prep as a Center, Left Tackle, Nose, and 3 Tech. I specialize in the offensive side of the ball, particularly the run game. In my 4 years coaching at Stanton College prep, I have elevated from a general assistant to being the co-Offensive Coordinator, while also serving as the run game coordinator and the offensive line coach. In that 4 years, I have had 3 of my players earn all state honors, as well as having on break our dominating (pancake) block record. I also helped lead the team to our second best season in school history, while also earning the school's first playoff appearance.

I specialize in Offense, particularly in the run game and pass protection. I have had two significant mentors in my coaching career, each with drastically different backgrounds; one being an old school Delaware Wing-T coach, the other learning under the Mike Leach air raid tree. This has given me a wide perspective on offense, and has allowed me to teach any scheme to any player.

I look to not only help my players grow as athletes, but as young men. The greatest part about coaching at the high school level is getting to watch the grow on and, more importantly, off the field. I focus on teaching technique and skills, as well as a large emphasis on the mental and schematic aspects of the game.
